dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fitting from the dorsal insertion to the apex on the trailing edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological point with a broad pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.4 times the vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex semi-circular curve with a smooth transition from the blowhole region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak with a low length-to-width ratio extending from the melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon convexity meets the dorsal rostrum plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple dark, circular pixel clusters (spots) visible on the anterior and mid-lateral flanks.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlights on the mid-body and high-contrast teal-cyan color gradient.
